sources.title: Afghanistan travel advice
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Hungary
sources.officialityEvidence: Hungary MFA's live Konzinfo country guidance directly addresses Hungarian citizens, but says usable visa applications depend on a Taliban-accredited consular office and Foreign Ministry approval.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Magyar állampolgárok az országba kizárólag érvényes vízum birtokában utazhatnak be.

sources.title: Djibouti travel advice
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Hungary
sources.officialityEvidence: Hungary MFA's live Konzinfo guidance describes online tourist-visa application, but does not state that a Hungarian ordinary-passport visa is electronically issued before travel or displace other visitor routes.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Turista, vagy üzleti célú beutazás esetén a vízum online igényelhető.

sources.title: Iraq travel advice
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Hungary
sources.officialityEvidence: Hungary MFA's live guidance says EU visitors now use federal Iraq's pre-travel electronic route, while the Kurdistan Region retains arrival issuance; it therefore does not establish one Iraq-wide timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Itt megmaradt a lehetőség a belépéskor történő vízumfelvételre.

sources.title: Palestine travel advice
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Hungary
sources.officialityEvidence: Hungary MFA's live guidance says Palestine does not issue visas and describes Israeli-controlled, route-specific West Bank entry procedures rather than a territory-wide visitor status.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Palesztina nem ad ki vízumot, és az ellenőrzőpontok palesztin oldalán nincs útlevél ellenőrzés.

sources.title: South Sudan travel advice
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Hungary
sources.officialityEvidence: Hungary MFA's live guidance confirms that a tourist visa is needed but refers travellers only to South Sudan's Brussels embassy, without establishing the ordinary-passport issuance timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Vízum turista célú beutazás esetén: Vízum beszerzése szükséges.

sources.title: Turkmenistan travel advice
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Hungary
sources.officialityEvidence: Hungary MFA's live guidance excludes online and arrival application and says entry visas are exceptionally rare and require an invitation naming the entry point, so it is not an unconditional passport baseline.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Érkezéskor és online nem igényelhető vízum.

sources.title: Syria travel advice
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Hungary
sources.officialityEvidence: Hungary MFA's live guidance reports unpredictable air travel and limited or closed land border stations, without a current ordinary Hungarian-passport visitor issuance route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A szíriai szárazföldi határállomások nagy része nem, vagy csak korlátozott mértékben üzemel.
